text:
Don't stress about the 30 days rule - it is a technical legal requirement, but basically never enforced (and very frequently couples submit it later than 30 days - often it takes longer than this for the apostilles to be approved). You should be fine as long as you don't delay it unnecessarily. 

 In terms of registering, as far as I know you don't need both partners present - I certainly know of couples who have done it with just the Israeli there.
